summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Health Monitoring Dashboard. Backend APIs and WebSocket real-time updates working perfectly. Frontend UI loads correctly with all vital signs, charts, and monitoring components. Real-time data updates confirmed working with 3-second intervals.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast notifications block phone button interactions when alerts are active

passed_tests: Heart Rate card displays with real-time updates (68-80 bpm range)
Respiration Rate card displays with Steady status (14 breaths/min)
Sleep Status card shows dynamic sleep state (Deep/Light Sleep)
Fall Detection card shows 'No Fall Detected' status
Live Room Status displays presence, distance, light (17 lux), temp (23.9°C), motion (Minimal)
Alerts panel shows health alerts with severity indicators
Heart Rate Trend chart renders with proper data visualization
Respiration Trend chart renders with proper data visualization
Sleep Quality card shows hours/minutes and circular progress
Activity Level card shows movement status and steps count
Device Status shows Connected radar, Strong signal, 85%+ battery
Patient info bar displays Mary Johnson, Room 102, Age 72, Sleeping status
Real-time updates confirmed working (values change every 3 seconds)
Alert system triggers critical notifications for irregular heart rate
Notification button is clickable and functional
Chart period selectors are present and interactive

success_percentage.backend: 100% - All API endpoints and WebSocket functionality working
success_percentage.frontend: 95% - All core features working, minor toast overlay issue

action_item_for_main_agent: Minor UI improvement: Consider adjusting z-index or positioning of toast notifications to prevent them from blocking interactive elements like the phone button. This is a low-priority cosmetic issue and does not affect core monitoring functionality.
